about: Offer test set (D284, scripts/offers.js). English source with labels: the capability the brain should offer for each request, the first message of a first conversation, or none. Every other file holds the same requests in its language.

requests.m1: I'm vegetarian and allergic to nuts, so keep that in mind whenever you suggest recipes. What could I cook tonight?
requests.m2: From now on, always write to me in short bullet points: I find long paragraphs hard to read. What makes a good CV?
requests.m3: Please remember that my manager is called Sofia and that I work part-time, Monday to Thursday.
requests.pr1: I'm organising my sister's wedding next June and I'll be working on it with you for months: the guests, the budget, the caterer, the music. Let's start with the budget.
requests.pr2: I'm writing my master's thesis on coral reefs and I'll come back to it every day until it's done. Today, help me outline chapter two.
requests.pr3: We're renovating our house this year, kitchen, bathroom and roof, and I want to keep all the quotes, notes and decisions in one place as we go. Where do I start?
requests.co1: Look through my Gmail inbox and tell me which emails need an answer today.
requests.co2: What meetings do I have in my Google Calendar tomorrow?
requests.co3: Add these three tasks to my to-do list in Notion: call the bank, book the dentist, renew my passport.
requests.he1: Write a complete welcome pack for our new employees: a welcome letter, a first-week schedule, an IT setup checklist, a glossary of our acronyms and an FAQ, each as its own document.
requests.he2: Write twelve different blog posts for our bakery's website, one for each month of the year, each about 600 words with a seasonal recipe.
requests.he3: Prepare our association's annual report: a summary of the year, a separate section for each of our five working groups, the accounts explained in plain words, and a plan for next year.
requests.pi1: Draw me a picture of a cat wearing an astronaut helmet, floating in space.
requests.pi2: Make an illustration for my bakery's poster: a smiling croissant on a blue background.
requests.pi3: Can you create a logo for my gardening business, Green Thumb?
requests.sy1: I use you on my office computer and on my laptop at home. How can I have the same conversations on both?
requests.sy2: Tomorrow I'll be working from my other computer. Will everything we did today be there?
requests.sy3: I've just bought a new laptop. Can I find all my conversations and files on it too?
requests.se1: What's the weather forecast for Lisbon this weekend?
requests.se2: What are the Louvre's opening hours this week, and how much is a ticket now?
requests.se3: What's the euro to Japanese yen exchange rate today?
requests.fo1: I have a folder on my computer with 200 scanned invoices. Rename each file with its date and the supplier's name.
requests.fo2: Go through the Documents folder on my laptop and tell me which files I haven't touched in years.
requests.ro1: Every Monday morning, send me a short summary of the week ahead and a motivational quote.
requests.ro2: Remind me tomorrow at 9 to call the plumber.
requests.cm1: What is the exact monthly payment on a 250,000 euro loan at 3.7% over 25 years, and how much interest will I pay in total?
requests.cm2: Simulate rolling two dice 10,000 times and tell me how often each total comes up.
requests.br1: Open the Wikipedia page about the Eiffel Tower next to our conversation, so we can read it together.
requests.br2: Show me the Paris city hall's website: I want to look at it while we talk.
requests.sk1: Every week I'll give you my meeting notes, and I always want them in the same format: decisions, who does what, deadlines, then open questions. Let's set this up so you always do it this way.
requests.sk2: Each time I send you a customer complaint, answer it by our rules: apologise first, then explain, then offer a voucher, and sign 'The Customer Team'. Keep this as the way to do it.
requests.de1: Make a poster for our school's spring fair: Saturday 16 May, 10 am to 4 pm, in the playground. Games, cakes and a raffle.
requests.de2: I need invitations for my parents' 40th wedding anniversary dinner, on Saturday 6 June at 8 pm at Le Jardin restaurant in Lille.
requests.de3: Can you make a flyer for my dog-walking service? 10 euros a walk, Monday to Friday, call Marc on 06 12 34 56 78.
requests.n2: Write a short poem about autumn leaves.
requests.n3: What is the capital of Australia?
requests.n4: Explain in simple words how vaccines work.
requests.n5: Help me write a polite email to my landlord asking him to fix the heating.
requests.n6: Translate into Spanish: 'Thank you for your help, see you next week.'
requests.n7: Give me three birthday gift ideas for my father, who loves fishing.
requests.n8: What's the difference between a virus and a bacterium?
requests.n9: Rewrite this to sound more professional: 'hey, the report's gonna be late, sorry'.
requests.n10: I feel a bit stressed about my job interview tomorrow. Any advice?
requests.n11: Describe what a traditional Japanese garden looks like.
